record.paper_title: Boundary and Defect CFT: Open Problems and Applications
record.original_question: To what extent can supersymmetry, the conformal bootstrap, integrability, topological field theory, and the other techniques discussed in the proceedings be turned into effective tools for answering the main open questions of boundary and defect conformal field theory?

evidence.quote: To what extent can SUSY, the conformal bootstrap, integrability, topological field theory, and the other techniques discussed in these proceedings be used to address such questions?

artifact.category_tag: Boundary and defect conformal field theory
artifact.status_search_result: This is a broad programmatic question about whether several techniques (SUSY, conformal bootstrap, integrability, TQFT) can be turned into effective tools for boundary/defect CFT. Substantial progress has been made on each technique since 2018 (e.g., numerical bootstrap bounds for BCFT, localization computations for defects, integrable defects in N=4 SYM, generalized symmetries via topological defects), but the overarching program remains open and is the subject of ongoing research.

status_evidence.title: Boundary and Defect CFT: Open Problems and Applications
status_evidence.snippet: Proceedings collecting open questions on boundary/defect CFT and the role of SUSY, bootstrap, integrability, and TFT.
status_evidence.claim: The question is posed as a broad open methodological challenge.
